test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some shows are good.

Some movies are good.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some good are movies.

II. Some good are shows.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed33ae01b6b02ea3ef3b80d1902612dfbe3327943a73a6123948265a8cf58581.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some good are movies. → **Follows** (As, Some movies are good)

II. Some good are shows. → **Follows** (As, Some shows are good)

Hence, '**Both conclusions I and II follow**' is the correct answer.
